A '''2-1B surgical droid''' was stationed inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] patched up [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] after his staged "assassination" death and loaded the facial transformation program to morph his physical features to exactly match that of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], the actor who also portrays [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].
